summary.overlap_note: Fold 4 and the locked holdout evaluate the exact same late calendar week (Sep 06–12, 2026) where all 6 failure episodes manifest. They are not independent validation experiments; they evaluate the same underlying telemetry period under slightly different training-prefix and scoring contexts (Fold 4 PR-AUC = 0.8306 vs Locked Holdout PR-AUC = 0.8220).
summary.scientific_interpretation: Event weighting reduces the influence of event-free folds, raising the rolling summary to 0.556; however, this remains materially below the locked late-period holdout (0.822) and therefore does not by itself establish robust temporal generalization. Furthermore, Fold 4 evaluates the exact same period as the locked holdout. Robust temporal generalization remains UNRESOLVED until evaluated on genuinely unseen multi-year external SCADA (CARE/WindADBench).

folds.reason: PR-AUC mathematically undefined when positive count is zero; excluded from valid-fold macro average.

methodological_guardrails.zero_positive_rule: Fold 1 PR-AUC set to null (not coerced to 0.0)

View C: Event-Level Alarm System (episode detection recall and lead time)
methodological_guardrails.exploratory_warning: Event-weighted PR-AUC is non-standard and reported for exploratory comparison only.
methodological_guardrails.temporal_overlap_flag: Fold 4 and Locked Holdout evaluate the same late-period data.
